params.body:
The Reports tab showed reports still to come between the published ones. It now lays them out as the reports page on gentells.com does: the published reports with their covers, then Coming next, each by title with the month the site gives it.

## What changes

- `Report.out`, from the site's `/api/app/reports` (Trendwolves/gentells-site#247). A site without the field sends none, and every report counts as out, so the list stays as it was.
- `ReportsScreen`: published reports as cards, then Coming next as rows. "Your plan opens N of M" counts the published reports only.

## Checked

- `SiteTest.aReportIsOutUnlessTheSiteSaysItIsComing`: `out` true, false and missing.
- Screenshot `6c-reports-coming-next`: one published report, two coming.
- `./gradlew :shared:allTests :androidApp:testDebugUnitTest :androidApp:assemblePreview`: 69 tests pass, the preview APK builds.
params.title: List coming reports under Coming next, as the reports page does
